name: marisa
description: Static, space-efficient MARISA trie data structures for DuckDB. Build a compact searchable string set as a single BLOB, then run lookups, prefix searches, and predictive completions against it. The lookup primitive for autocomplete, spell-check, and routing tables.

cta.title: Compact String Lookups in SQL
cta.description: Install Marisa to build and query MARISA tries — fast, memory-tight string sets for autocomplete, spell-check, prefix routing, and dedupe.
